What Is This

An Interactive Sculpture. A Troll With Electronics.

CHUD Gnome is a fixed-scope sponsored prototype program to transform a sculptural concept into a serviceable, pilot-ready interactive character.

🔴
LED Eyes + PIR Sensor
WS2812B eyes glow when it senses you entering range. PIR sensor hidden in the hat crown. You can't sneak up on it.
🎙️
Microphone Array + LLM Voice
Acoustic ports hidden in the beard feed into a speech-to-text pipeline and cloud or local LLM routing. Episodic memory. It remembers you.
⚙️
Raspberry Pi Pico + Service Door
IP65-gasketed rear access door. Pico-class control board and modular electronics are removable without destroying the exterior shell. Ballast weight for stability. Down-firing speaker.
🔒
Privacy by Design
Opt-in familiarity tokens. No covert identity database. Configurable intensity, prohibited-topic rules, mute, and hard power-off.
